progress_and_boundary.degenerate_boundary: g=0 permits free crossings, repeated initial positions are singular phase points, and N=1 is a trivial free-particle boundary; all are excluded from the main theorem
progress_and_boundary.model_boundary: confining, trigonometric, hyperbolic, elliptic, spin, complex, and quantum spectral variants are outside the claim
progress_and_boundary.operator_boundary: the natural quantum Hamiltonian supplies only a source-native quantization route, not a Hilbert--Polya operator or target identification
progress_and_boundary.periodic_boundary: the unbounded continuous flow has no ordinary finite Artin--Mazur orbit census; no prime-orbit or zeta claim is manufactured
progress_and_boundary.progress: one paper closes the complete classical free rational flow, all trace integrals, the two-ended scattering map and ordering reversal, a global inverse atlas, and the periodic-orbit obstruction
progress_and_boundary.proof_boundary: the all-parameter statement follows from the rank-one commutator and Hermitian perturbation proof plus classical source ownership; finite regression is not promoted to proof

theorem.aperiodicity: for N>=2 and g>0 the simple asymptotic velocities are not all equal, so every trajectory is unbounded in relative configuration and no bounded nonconstant periodic orbit exists
theorem.asymptotics: if lambda_1<...<lambda_N are the simple eigenvalues of L_0 and a_m=v_m^*Q_0v_m with e^*v_m=1, then x_j(t)=t lambda_j+a_j+O(t^(-1)) as t->+infinity and x_j(t)=t lambda_(N+1-j)+a_(N+1-j)+O(|t|^(-1)) as t->-infinity, with velocity errors O(t^(-2))
theorem.global_dynamics: the pencil eigenvalues and their first derivatives form the unique complete collision-free Hamiltonian solution with ddot q_j=2g^2 sum_(k!=j)(q_j-q_k)^(-3)
theorem.integrals: L(t) is unitarily conjugate to L_0, so Tr L(t)^k=Tr L_0^k for every k>=1; in particular Tr L^2=2H
theorem.ordering_reversal: the spectral line (lambda_m,a_m) has incoming ordered rank N+1-m and outgoing ordered rank m; the intercept attached to that spectral line is unchanged
theorem.pencil_solution: for every N>=2, g>0, q_1<...<q_N, and p in R^N, the physical ordered positions are the increasingly ordered eigenvalues of X(t)=Q_0+tL_0 for every real t
theorem.quantum_boundary: the same inverse-square potential has a natural semibounded Schrodinger realization on the ordered chamber, but this is only A4_NATURAL_QUANTIZATION and no target spectrum is identified
theorem.scattering_atlas: ordered lambda and arbitrary real a give Q_tilde_(aa)=a_a and Q_tilde_(ab)=ig/(lambda_b-lambda_a); diagonalizing Q_tilde recovers uniquely an ordered Calogero--Moser phase point, giving a global algebraic spectral atlas
theorem.simple_spectrum: X(t) has simple spectrum for every real t, because [X(t),L_0]=ig(J-I) and a repeated eigenspace would force a rank-one compression of J to equal an identity of rank at least two
